_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Virginia Beach. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Cape Henry Lighthouse
deals.deal: $20 admission for seniors 60+, military and AAA members (regularly $22)
deals.details: Student admission is $8. The lighthouse is on Joint Expeditionary Base Fort Story: visitors over 16 need a REAL ID, and visitors 18+ without military ID must submit SECNAV Form 5512. Closed Thanksgiving, Dec. 24-25 and Dec. 28-Jan. 1.

deals.name: Rudee Tours
deals.deal: Whale watching: guaranteed sightings or ride again free; $38.16 senior rate
deals.details: Whale watching cruises run December through February. If no whales are seen, passengers may ride again for free (no refunds). Adults are $40.28, seniors 65+ $38.16 and children $33.92.

deals.name: Virginia Aquarium & Marine Science Center
deals.deal: $2 off admission for active military and veterans
deals.details: Military adult admission is $33 (regularly $35) and youth admission is $28 (regularly $30) with valid military ID.

deals.name: Virginia MOCA
deals.deal: Free admission for Virginia residents and children under 12
deals.details: Non-residents pay $16.50; adults 65+, active military, first responders, teachers and students pay $11 with ID. Museums for All: free for up to four people with an EBT card and photo ID.

deals.name: Catch 31
deals.deal: Happy hour: $4 domestic beer and house wine, $5 mixed drinks, $6 Orange Crush
deals.details: Daily 3-6 PM in the bar and cocktail areas. Signature margarita, mojito and mule are $6; happy hour food includes $8 coconut shrimp and $9 cheese curds.

deals.name: Driftwood Kitchen
deals.deal: High Five Happy Hour: $5 wines, well drinks and bottled beer
deals.details: Happy hour runs 3-6 PM with discounted appetizers. The restaurant is closed Mondays.

deals.name: Hunt Room at The Cavalier
deals.deal: Hunt's End Happy Hour: $5 draft beer and Coastal Cocktails, $6 wine and well drinks
deals.details: Every weeknight 4-6 PM. A bartender's choice cocktail is $6 and appetizers are $7.

deals.name: CP Shuckers Cafe & Raw Bar (Shore Drive)
deals.deal: Tuesday Burger Night: half-pound burger with 2 toppings for $9.99
deals.details: Tuesday special at the Shore Drive location. The same night lists 1.5 lb crab legs with hush puppies for $28.99 and $5.50 select crushes.
